articles.summary: Charles Mosher Named Executive Vice President, Chief Audit Executive; Michael Thompson Appointed Senior Vice President, Interim Chief Accounting Officer; Lisa Washington Promoted to Executive Vice President, Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary WSFS Financial Corporation (Nasdaq: WSFS), today announced the appointment of Charles “Chuck” Mosher as Executive Vice President, Chief Audit Executive, and the promotion of Lisa Washington, to Executive Vice President, Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary, effective today. Mosher and Washington are both experienced members of the WSFS senior leadership team and will continue to lead two critical areas of the company’s governance and risk management framework. Mosher is a Certified Public Accountant and joined WSFS over 25 years ago and has served in a variety of leadership positions in the Finance and Accounting groups.
